_comment: A lone block of 140 Spearmen (9 files of 16, close order, 9 wu pitch) facing east, doubled to 18 files of 8 by the alternate-rank explicatio (Polyaenus, Stratagems 2.10.4) read files first: Alt+B steps the drill to the alternate rank, Alt+Ctrl+Shift+B steps the opening from together to files first, and a plain B deals it. Each old file opens out to its distance from the middle file outward with every man still in it, each man keeping his place behind the man ahead of him in it, read from where they stand, and only once its file leader settles does its every second man step into the interval beside the man ahead of him and come up, each man once he sees the man ahead of him settle or step out (Bingham's note on Aelian 29.3: the doubling must be done in open order, the files standing apart when the men march up between them; doing the opening first is the sim's inference). explicatio_following counts the men still following: 136 at tick 120, while the files open, 32 at tick 900, 4 at tick 1200, and null from tick 1260, the files opening a man at a time down each file. The front rank keeps its line at x 587.5 and the block settles at [556.03, 384.5]. Measured 2026-11-20 on FULL dumps every 60 ticks to tick 1320 (2026-11-19 every 10 ticks to tick 1500 for where the block settles) on seed runs 0 to 4, which play out identically (no enemy, no roll). On main, which has no opening reading, Alt+Ctrl+Shift+B steps the side to inward instead, so the block settles at y 375.5, and the dump has no explicatio_following, so those expects fail there. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).

misslotted.reason: Files first, a man waiting in his unopened old file stands behind the man ahead of him in it, as the reading means, not behind the man the dumped relations name: those are the finished grid's (DemoState.relations), so while the block stands still with men still waiting the misslot reading counts them as swapped. 0.936 and 0.914 of the men at ticks 960 and 1020 on each of seed runs 0 to 4 (0.936 at tick 1020 alone before the man ahead was read from his body, measured 2026-11-20), 0.079 at 1080, 0.014 at 1200, and 0 once the drill ends; an exemption cannot name a tick window.
